operator_messages.text: the decision is more narrow than that. its not "**what must accompany `bundle/` when it is distributed**", its "must this bundle be distributed beyond this repo?"

exactly, an exemplar isn't merly a template its something to point to as known good. so, I say no this bundle does not need to be distrbuted therefore it may reference outside of the boundle but that needs to be bound to the repo of paths. ruling_summary: This bundle is a known-good exemplar within its repository, not an independently distributed artifact. Local references may leave bundle/ but must resolve inside this repository. Material in another filesystem checkout must be addressed by a Git-hosted URL, not a filesystem pointer.
